rules.baseline: Actual source decision and simulator functions; no additional filter.
rules.adx-ichimoku: Wilder ADX14 >=25, directional DI agreement; Tenkan9 versus Kijun26 and close beyond both current displayed 9/26/52 cloud spans (computed 26 bars ago). No Chikou future lookup.
rules.chaikin-envelope: Chaikin ADL EMA3 minus EMA10 agrees with side; long close below SMA20*0.975, short above SMA20*1.025. Conventional oscillator, not the Gunbot snippet's EMA seeds.
rules.keltner-obv: Close on directional side of EMA20 but at most 2*Wilder ATR20 away; OBV change over five closed bars agrees with side. Pullback/anti-chase overlay, NOT literal Gunbot breakout.
rules.macd-donchian: MACD12/26 histogram over EMA9 signal agrees; close breaks preceding 20-bar high for long / low for short. Channel excludes current bar.
rules.tsf-bop: OLS close forecast one bar ahead from latest 14 closed bars exceeds last close for long, below for short; mean 14-bar (close-open)/(high-low) agrees. Model forecast is not future observed data.
rules.williams-stochastic: 14-bar Williams %R long <=-80 / short >=-20; raw Stochastic K above/below its 3-bar SMA D respectively. Both oscillators mathematically share the same price-range information.
rules.rsi-ma: Wilder RSI14 above/below 50 and close above/below EMA50, according to direction.
rules.range-rsi-bb: Long RSI14<=30 and close below SMA20-2 population standard deviations; short RSI>=70 above upper band.
rules.rsi-only: Wilder RSI14 long >50 and <75; short <50 and >25; control for existing momentum information, not a new standalone engine.
rules.vwap-ad: Rolling 20-bar VWAP = native summed quote volume / summed base volume; directional close comparison and five-bar ADL change. Rolling trade-price VWAP, NOT session VWAP or execution VWAP.

protocol.costStress: Repeat EVERY arm at 2x both fee and impact/slippage, never only an ex-post winner.
protocol.decisionContract: Admission veto only; cannot originate/flip a trade, alter original SL/TP or change existing execution. Futures chosen timeframe; Spot daily LONG. Strict native close<decision. Identical data and capital for paired arms. No parameter tuning.
protocol.dataContract: Public native Binance Spot and USD-M history only, no keys/accounts. 250 bars warmup (Spot 260 capture, actual existing simulator requests 220). Request cap 120. Replay entirely offline. No inference for MEXC/Gate.
protocol.acceptance: Exploratory screening, not strategy approval. Robust lead requires positive MTM and incremental improvement in BOTH independent quarters, under normal and doubled costs, no worse maximum drawdown, positive closed-net, and at least 30 closed trades per market/arm. Even passing screening is not profitability proof; independent prospective validation remains required.
protocol.limitations: Uses last observed runtime source SHA, not reverified current Production. Macro/stablecoin historical context unavailable held null/equally disabled; no AI Supervisor, account fill, execution replay or scanner universe. Futures daily decision/4h execution, separate per-symbol capital sleeves. Spot actual daily DCA simulator with limited 220-bar initial structural warmup. Not exact Gunbot strategies; this tests incremental value inside existing engine only. 10 hypotheses, 3 retrospectively selected large-cap symbols, two quarters; no statistical generalization. Q3/Q4 not used in prior Q1/Q2 pilot, but not a blind prospective holdout.

protocol.reason: Primary Q3/Q4 Spot replay has 0 baseline closed trades; actual simulator requests 220 bars, market-map adequate-history threshold is 400. This supplementary diagnostic isolates history sufficiency, not tuned admission thresholds.
protocol.timing: Registered AFTER seeing primary Spot outputs; not preregistered confirmatory/out-of-sample evidence.
protocol.source: Use same exact source SHA, same periods, all 11 arms, both cost levels. No application file modifications.
protocol.data: Merge public native daily Spot files from previous Q1/Q2 and current Q3/Q4 capture; overlapping rows must match exactly, no gaps, full byte hashes verified. Extend ONLY injected historical transport start to 400 days before each fold. Future observations remain unavailable.
protocol.metrics: Separate files and conclusions from source-exact 220-day replay. No projected TP profits. No production parity claim. NO_PARAMETER_TUNING.
protocol.acceptance: Same screening thresholds as original protocol. Additional exploratory sensitivity cannot validate production profitability.
